name: Toosaka Rin
source:
A participant in the Holy Grail War who is fighting against the Harways. She closely resembles her Fate/stay night counterpart.

She is a proficient hacker and her servant is one of the two Lancers (resembles the Lancer from Fate/stay night).

[spoiler]Early in Fate/Extra CCC, Rin joins the student council to help the remaining masters to escape from the Far side of the moon.[/spoiler]
